decisions.reason: The front-box visual reference applies to this dashboard, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records it.

The front-box reference does not alter the footer's presentation or all-page coverage.
The front-box reference does not modify the internal-page header requirement.
Providing a front-box reference image does not change the required reusable fonts, icons, or design-asset handoff.
The front-box visual reference does not change the required editable variants, source format, or PDF-export capability.
